checkpoints.description: No price stated
checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

checkpoints.description: No hallucinated programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult Striking, Kids 3-6 BJJ, Kids 7-13 BJJ, Kids Striking. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Muay Thai, Gi BJJ, Vacaville programs, Grit programs).

checkpoints.description: No false closure
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

checkpoints.description: No unreplaced merge tokens
checkpoints.look_for: bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.

checkpoints.description: Discipline confirmed before booking — Jiu-Jitsu or Striking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks whether the lead wants Jiu-Jitsu or Striking before routing to any booking calendar. Booking must not proceed without an explicit discipline confirmation.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Adult BJJ routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead interested in Jiu-Jitsu is booked into the 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ' calendar. Booking to any other calendar for an adult JJ lead is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Adult Striking routes to Adult Striking calendar
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead interested in Striking is booked into the 'Adult Striking' calendar. Booking to any other calendar for an adult Striking lead is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kids 3-6 JJ routes to Kids 3-6 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 3-6 interested in Jiu-Jitsu is booked into 'Kids 3-6 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 7-13 BJJ or any other calendar for this age group is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kids 7-13 JJ routes to Kids 7-13 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 7-13 interested in Jiu-Jitsu is booked into 'Kids 7-13 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 3-6 BJJ or adult calendar for this age group is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kids 7-13 Striking routes to Kids Striking calendar
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 7-13 interested in Striking is booked into 'Kids Striking'. Booking to any adult or JJ calendar for this age group is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kids age 3-6 + Striking redirected to Kids JJ
checkpoints.look_for: if a child aged 3-6 wants Striking, bot must NOT book them into any calendar. Must inform that Striking starts at age 7 and offer Kids Jiu-Jitsu as the available alternative.

checkpoints.description: Open Mat acknowledged as non-bookable, redirected to trial
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about Open Mat (Sunday session), bot acknowledges it exists but states it is not available for online booking, then redirects to the free trial flow.

checkpoints.description: MMA Class acknowledged as non-bookable, redirected to trial
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about the MMA Class (Saturday), bot acknowledges it exists but states it is not available for online booking, then redirects to the free trial flow.

checkpoints.description: Pro Training acknowledged as invite-only, redirected
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about Pro Training, bot acknowledges it is invite-only and not bookable online, then redirects to the free trial flow.

checkpoints.description: Adults Advanced / Competition Class redirected to Fundamentals trial
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about Adults Advanced or Competition Class, bot explains that new students start with a free trial in the Fundamentals class and can discuss moving up with the coach after coming in.
